text: Those whose minds are purified by the discernment of Brahman’s knowledge perform, even now, what is exceedingly difficult: they relinquish wealth, even though it is meant for enjoyment, being utterly free from desire. We, however, are unable to renounce even the mere grasp of desire, whether for what is present, what was in the past, what is about to be, or what has already been attained.
